config.extra_support_points: Exact mass-target k from each full concentration curve
config.mode_stability_caveat: LOO history-operator robustness only; not a statistical perturbation bound. Close eigenvectors are labeled with caveats.
config.scope: Support profile of supplied space, not automatic global Fisher rank discovery
config.recovery: Reuse completed per-direction profiles unchanged; column-wise equivalent score accumulation fixes CUDA large-index launch

limitations: Per-mode profiles depend on basis choice; whole-space leverage and Frobenius profiles are rotation invariant.
JVP responses are local derivatives at theta128, not finite-step CE or expert accuracy.
Rho masks use probe0 only; probe1 checks use the exact same masks without reselection.
Support sizes are empirical profiles, never identified with supplied subspace dimension.
